pages.title: Hand of the Demiurge
pages.text: The craftsman of the world had to hold it somehow. The only thing that can tune, wake or move an Omnipotence Core.

The only thing that can handle a forged Omnipotence Core. Sneak and use it in the air to change mode:$(li)$(thing)Tune$(): turn the Core's resonance (sneak: the other way) until it is in tune with the place$(li)$(thing)Activate$(): wake a Core in tune - or let an awake one sleep$(li)$(thing)Move$(): lift the Core into your inventory (it must be tuned again where you set it down)$(br2)It does not work on the Core of the Transcendental.
